protocol.decision_index: zero at reset; one-based recorded decision producing each subsequent tick
protocol.probabilities: original model scores before epsilon exploration, preserved without renormalizing
protocol.image_fallback: When native state is unavailable, hold the last real RGB image; image_tick identifies it
protocol.success: positive observed kill-count delta before the task deadline

selection.rule: No Jev/NanoJev-success and baseline-failure intersection exists; select a NanoJev-only success with greatest initial visible target horizontal offset, ties by case ID
